notes: suspectNames flagged 'Her Soul Shackles' as a near-miss of 'soul shackles' — that's just capitalization/pronoun around the real R name, no correction needed, false positive. missingInteractions also listed 'terrain-cuts-retreat' for Black Shield (E), but enemyKit's own E flags include 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' while Riot's text describes E purely as a damage-absorb barrier with no terrain/wall behavior — this looks like a flag misfire (tooltip parser picking up Morgana's W zone-terrain-adjacent behavior or a shared flag template), so per the calibration rule (trust the description over a contradicting flag) I did not add a Flash-for-the-wall claim about Black Shield; flagging for review rather than fabricating.
